title: Focus activation latency, stage by stage (P6 focus finding)
layer: nested KWin, virtual backend (OpenGL on the reference host's GPU); NOT physical

environment.host: reference desktop (AMD Ryzen 5 5600X, Linux 7.2.9), nested sessions only

input: libei through the nested KWin's EIS socket (plastile-keytap-ei), the physical kit's chords

stages.tap_entry: key-down written -> command handler entry in QV4
stages.assign: duration of the workspace.activeWindow assignment (Workspace::activateWindow, including every synchronous windowActivated/activeChanged handler)
stages.active_turn: windowActivated -> a 0 ms timer started there fires
stages.turn_config: that timer -> the fixture receives the activation configure
stages.tap_config: key-down -> activation configure received (the physical kit's inputToConfigure)

samplesPerCondition: 2 blocks x 300 (5 warm-up taps per block discarded), one fresh nested session per block, randomized block order

aurorae-tiled.description: Aurorae v2 + the reference desktop's SVG theme; frames tiled by Plastile (master/stack, 4 windows)

aurorae-small.description: Aurorae v2 + SVG theme; KWin's placement (400x300 clients), as the physical P00-switch baseline

aurorae-populated.description: as aurorae-tiled plus 14 more fixtures spread over 5 other desktops (18 windows, 6 desktops)

nosvg-tiled.description: Aurorae v2 without a theme (it logs 'Could not find decoration svg' and paints nothing); tiled frames

bisect-4afc10e.description: Aurorae + SVG theme, tiled; Plastile built from 4afc10e (the windowed-GPU run's build), diagnostics=info

bisect-97fec4a.description: Aurorae + SVG theme, tiled; Plastile built from 97fec4a (the physical P6 run's installed build)

bisect-current-info.description: Aurorae + SVG theme, tiled; this branch's Plastile, diagnostics=info (pairs with bisect-4afc10e)

physicalReanalysis.source: physical P6 run 2026-10-18 (evidence/physical-runbook-20261018.json), raw fixture logs re-read by probes/perf/focus/area.py
physicalReanalysis.note: P00-switch ran on KWin-placed 400x300 clients (no tiler); P03-focus on Plastile's tiles (144 Hz: 2560x1440 output, 60 Hz: 1920x1080) except at 100 Hz, where the context's layout was floating and the fixtures kept 400x300

review.layer: nested KWin, virtual backend; NOT physical (except physicalPhase, which re-reads the physical raw logs)
review.samplesPerCondition: 3 blocks x 300 (5 warm-up taps per block discarded), one fresh nested session per block, randomized block order
review.probe: probes/perf/focus/run.py (--floating added in review), probes/perf/focus/area.py, probes/perf/focus/phase.py

aurorae-floating.description: Aurorae v2 + the reference desktop's SVG theme; Plastile loaded with its context's layout floating before the fixtures map (--floating), so every condition, Plastile's focus.next included, activates KWin's 400x300 placement (as the physical P03-focus context at 100 Hz)

aurorae-tiled.description: repeat of aurorae-tiled (Aurorae + SVG theme, tiled frames), 3 blocks per condition

breeze-tiled.description: repeat of breeze-tiled (Breeze, tiled frames), 3 blocks per condition

physicalPhase.source: physical P6 run 2026-10-18, raw samples and fixture logs re-read by probes/perf/focus/phase.py
physicalPhase.method: phase of the key-down within the refresh cycle, from the latest wp_presentation timestamp before it (within 1 s) extended by refresh_ns; eight equal bins from that vblank; median inputToConfigure ms per bin

review.note: src/ and the bundle at c54cfcf; the probe ran from the review's working tree (run.py with --floating, otherwise unchanged)
